core_idea: The best CV tool is the one that keeps your real facts and adds none.
analogy: A good darzi: takes the shirt in, never sews on a pocket you didn't have. Kept on every beat; 'pocket' = an invented skill or number.

beats.line0: Frame 0: 'CHATGPT vs GEMINI vs CLAUDE' at 120 px or more in Playfair, three empty column headers below with a small red chip 'INVENTED'. Host centre, stage content above y 560.
beats.line1: Phone card: the old 2-page CV (real, redacted), page counter '2 PAGES' in amber, a 'between jobs' kicker with a night clock.
beats.line2: The one prompt types into a prompt box, then fans out into three columns (one per app, labelled 'FREE').
beats.line3: Darzi diagram: a shirt outline gets taken in (green check), a ghost pocket appears and is struck red (X).
beats.line4: Host hidden, full width (left 90, right 90). Three matching columns, the same rows in each, chips build top to bottom: green = fact kept, red = invented skill or number. One-page meter under each column fills to its real page count. Counts are the real filming-day counts.
beats.line5: Payoff: the winning tool's real one-page CV as a full card (redacted), green ticks down the margin, verdict chip '{{WINNER}}: KEPT MOST, INVENTED LEAST'. Small 'WHO PICKS WHICH' strip: '{{PICK_LINE}}'.
beats.line6: The catch: one red line from the test circled in amber with 'READ EVERY LINE'.
beats.line7: End card: 'Save.' in serif, bookmark shape, dark pill 'Comment RESUME', sticker 'FREE PROMPT'.

test.rule: Run on filming day: same real CV, same prompt, free tier of ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, fresh chat each, no memory or custom instructions. Screenshot every output. The verdict is whatever the screenshots show; nothing on screen is drawn from memory or guessed.
test.cv_source: {{whose CV, written consent, and what is redacted: name, phone, email, employer if asked}}
test.WINNER: {{the tool with the most facts kept and fewest inventions; if two tie, rewrite line 5 to say so, never pick one}}
test.PICK_LINE: {{one short, test-backed line on who should pick which, e.g. which one fit one page; leave it out if the test does not support it}}
test.if_winner_missed_one_page: Keep line 5 as written and show its real page count on the meter. Do not claim it fit.
